title: Add one of two similar contacts to favorites in Contacts

setup.why: No contact with this run's nonce is left from an earlier try.
Two contacts with the same surname and initial, neither a favorite: the decoy and the one to star.

argv: sh -c "$1" sh add computer-bench-{{nonce}}-1 "$2 {{nonce}}" '415 555 0142' && sh -c "$1" sh add computer-bench-{{nonce}}-2 "$3 {{nonce}}" '415 555 0199'

setup.why: Open the contacts app on its list, with its permissions granted.

instruction: In Contacts, add "{{p.target}} {{nonce}}" to your favorites. Leave the other contacts as they are.

checks.why: Lists this run's contacts by name with their starred flag: {{p.target}} is starred and {{p.decoy}} is not, and both are still there. Setup starred neither, so an agent that does nothing fails, and so does one that starred the decoy.

teardown.why: Delete every contact holding the nonce.

oracle.why: Wait for the contact list: on a fresh phone it shows a moment after am start -W returns.
The second row under a letter is named by its contact (the first by the letter), which is why the target sorts after the decoy.
